title: Padlock Key
summary: Unlocks the chains that can bind you when Priestess Gut captures you.

fields.Use: The chains apply if you are immune to Gut’s sleeping potion, such as when playing an elf or drow.
fields.Acquisition: On the bed behind Polma in the Defiled Temple, X 391, Y 3.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
